description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Gravelgill Axeshark.
When Gravelgill Axeshark dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Hardened Academic triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Gravelgill Axeshark.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.
